The '''Swamplands''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. The [[Thoi]] and [[Lajune]] lived in the Swamplands. [[Jigani Port]], the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Desevro, was also located in the Swamplands
